title: Hidden Reach
wikitext:
[[File:The Hidden Reach.jpg|thumb|The Hidden Reach]]

'''The Hidden Reach''' is the name given to a secret entrance to [[Dire Maul]] East which bypasses the usual hazards of getting into the keep from its usual entrance. It is accessed by the [[Lariss Pavilion]] located in the forest area north of [[Camp Mojache]]. Along the western rim of the pavilion is a downward spiral ramp whose northern area has the door to The Hidden Reach. This door can only be accessed by use of the {{loot|common|Crescent Key}}. Once open, there is a winding tunnel that goes down to an instance portal. Once crossed, the adventurer(s) will be in a corridor that leads to the easternmost portion of [[Dire Maul East]]. The area is guarded by [[lasher]]s and [[satyr]]s.

If one goes through the standard instance portal in the [[Broken Commons]] in order to kill [[Pusillin]] and obtain the Crescent Key, one has to pass through [[Warpwood Quarter]] to get to the Hidden Reach. A tunnel leads off near the entrance through a large unnamed area containing [[Lethtendris]], [[Hydrospawn]], and [[Zevrim Thornhoof]] and eventually down into the [[Conservatory]].
